name: Iris Flint
source_profile: ● Iris Flint (NG) is a respected assayer whose expertise in evaluating precious metals has earned her the trust of independent prospectors. She is particularly suspicious of fraudulent mining claims and has occasionally refused to certify shipments whose origins or composition appear questionable.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 45 (source excerpt; may be partial)
